split.description: Preserve five repetitions of ten source trial partitions and all 50 held-out fits per session. Models 1-10 hold permutation residues 1-9 then 0; bind original trial order, complementary train/test identities and once-per-repeat coverage. inputs.description: Original instantaneous RADICaL rates from the top 100 source lift-modulated cells predict all 24 joint angles. Bind original ZETA cell selection, observation horizon and feature ordering. Candidate methods may improve the decoder but may not gain extra neurons, biological observations or target exposure. Relevant author alternative/control branches keep their distinct original inputs.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source joint-angle interpolation and 15-ms Gaussian smoothing, lift-locked -100 to +400 ms on the 10-ms grid (51 timepoints), unsmoothed RADICaL rates and pre-CV PCA retaining 90% of neuron count. Authenticate source ordering and exposure of ZETA/PCA instead of silently substituting train-only processing or permitting extra test-target access; controls retain branch-specific processing.

metric.description: Per joint and original fit, VE = 1 - Var(y - yhat)/Var(y), using MATLAB sample-variance semantics over concatenated held-out trial timepoints. Retain negative VE and resolve source zero-variance handling. This is not SSE/SST R-squared; constant prediction offsets leave VE unchanged. Exact complete numeric references and qualified agreement/improvement rules remain unresolved.

aggregation.description: Preserve the complete 5-mouse x 2-area x 50-fit x 24-joint panel. plotVEAll takes median over 50 fits per joint, then median of those joint medians for proximal joints 1-7 and distal joints 8-24 within each mouse/area. Compare differences of original summaries, not median paired-score differences or a pooled scalar. Keep all four area/group outputs, mouse pairing and companions; favorable subsets cannot win.

full_panel.description: Complete original Figure 5 score panel, all five mice/ten sessions/50 fits/24 joints, source nested medians, observed/decoded trajectories and source-reconstructed postures, reviewed decoder companion branches and matched VE/variance pairs. Preserve original display selections and branch identities. The distinct intervention family is retained context, not part of the selected primary.
